title: LED Street Lighting
scope: Requirements for LED luminaires used for road and street lighting.
description: Specifies performance and safety requirements for outdoor LED street lighting. Covers efficacy, color rendering, thermal management, and electrical safety.

title: Electrical Safety for Lighting Equipment
scope: Safety requirements for electrical lighting equipment.
description: Specifies electrical safety requirements, safety tests, and protection mechanisms for lighting devices. Covers IP65/IP66 enclosures and outdoor applications.

title: Concrete for Construction
scope: Specifications for concrete used in building and construction.
description: Defines quality requirements for concrete, compressive strength testing, and durability criteria. Includes mix designs for different environmental conditions.

title: Portland Cement Specifications
scope: Quality and performance requirements for Portland cement.
description: Specifies physical and chemical properties of Portland cement, testing procedures, and packaging requirements.

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Safety Helmets
scope: Requirements for protective safety helmets used in construction and industrial environments.
description: Covers design, materials, testing, and certification of safety helmets. Includes impact resistance and retention system specifications.

title: Cotton Textiles - Quality Control
scope: Quality parameters and testing methods for cotton textile products.
description: Defines strength requirements, dimensional stability, color fastness, and safety requirements for cotton fabrics and garments.

title: Food Safety and Quality - Edible Oils
scope: Safety and quality standards for edible oils and fats.
description: Specifies purity requirements, testing methods for contaminants, and packaging standards for edible oils including coconut, palm, and groundnut oils.

title: Automotive Lubricating Oils
scope: Requirements for lubricating oils used in automotive engines.
description: Defines viscosity, thermal stability, corrosion protection, and performance metrics for engine oils. Includes testing procedures and quality grades.

title: Mechanical Power Transmission - Belt Drives
scope: Design and specifications for belt drive systems.
description: Covers V-belt and flat belt specifications, pulley design, safety factors, and installation requirements for mechanical power transmission systems.

title: Water Quality and Testing
scope: Potable water quality parameters and testing methods.
description: Specifies physical, chemical, and microbiological parameters for drinking water, testing procedures, and acceptable limits for contaminants.

title: Steel Rebar for Reinforced Concrete
scope: Specifications for steel reinforcing bars used in concrete structures.
description: Defines mechanical properties, chemical composition, dimensional tolerances, and testing procedures for reinforcing steel bars.

title: LED Bulb Efficiency and Performance
scope: Energy efficiency and performance requirements for LED bulbs.
description: Specifies luminous flux, color temperature, lifespan, and power consumption limits for LED lighting products. Includes labeling requirements.

title: Electrical Cable Specifications
scope: Requirements for electrical cables used in power distribution and building wiring.
description: Covers insulation materials, voltage ratings, temperature ratings, testing procedures, and safety specifications for electrical cables. IP66 rated outdoor cables included.

title: Safety Glass and Glazing
scope: Requirements for tempered and safety glass used in construction.
description: Defines impact resistance, thermal stress resistance, and fragmentation characteristics for safety glazing materials.

title: Copper and Brass Fittings
scope: Quality specifications for copper and brass fittings used in plumbing and HVAC.
description: Specifies material composition, dimensional tolerances, pressure ratings, and corrosion resistance requirements for plumbing fittings.
